question: Were you married at the end of last year, and does anyone live with you that you support?
why_ask: Filing status sets the standard deduction, tax rates and filing threshold.
retrieval_query: how to choose filing status single head of household

question: Besides your regular job, did you earn money from anything else last year, for example ride-share, delivery, freelance or selling services?
why_ask: Self-employment income is reported on Schedule C and may owe self-employment tax.
retrieval_query: self-employment income who must file Schedule C
source: Form 13614-C income section; Schedule C instructions

question: About how much did you earn from that side work in total?
why_ask: Net self-employment earnings of $400 or more owe self-employment tax.
